positives: Zod-based validation middleware enforces strict type checking on all API endpoints
Search input sanitization via React controlled components prevents XSS injection
Filter parameters validated against predefined enums (category, severity, dateRange)
WebSocket message validation through TypeScript strict typing and JSON schema
LocalStorage data validated with timestamp checks and TTL enforcement
Zero usage of dangerouslySetInnerHTML across entire codebase

React automatic escaping protects all user-controlled data rendering
Helmet CSP headers block inline scripts in production mode
X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block header enabled for legacy browsers
evidence: Grep analysis: No dangerous patterns found in production code

positives: JWT-based authentication with Bearer token pattern
Authentication middleware validates JWT on every protected route
Token storage in localStorage/sessionStorage with secure retrieval
API client interceptors automatically attach auth tokens
JWT configuration validation at server startup
Token blacklist service for revoked tokens (Redis-backed)
API key authentication for service-to-service communication
RBAC middleware for role-based access control
concerns: LocalStorage token storage vulnerable to XSS (mitigated by React escaping)
No token refresh mechanism visible in client code
Default JWT_SECRET warning in development (acceptable for dev)
recommendations: Consider HttpOnly cookies for token storage (XSS immunity)
Implement automatic token refresh before expiration
Add rate limiting on authentication endpoints

Encrypt sensitive data before localStorage persistence
Hash or redact email addresses in audit logs (GDPR compliance)
Implement log level filtering (DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR)

vulnerabilities.description: Excessive console.log usage in production code may expose sensitive data
vulnerabilities.location: Multiple view components (Events, Fleet, CFNLoop, Agents)
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-532: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
vulnerabilities.impact: Low - Development debugging statements could leak data in production
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Implement conditional logging based on NODE_ENV
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add build-time log removal or conditional wrapper: if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'development') console.log(...)

vulnerabilities.description: LocalStorage stores sensitive data without encryption
vulnerabilities.cwe: CWE-311: Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data
vulnerabilities.impact: Low - LocalStorage accessible via browser DevTools
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Encrypt store state before localStorage persistence
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use crypto-js or Web Crypto API to encrypt state: AES-256-GCM

vulnerabilities.description: JWT tokens stored in localStorage vulnerable to XSS
vulnerabilities.impact: Low - Mitigated by React XSS protections and CSP headers
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Migrate to HttpOnly cookies for XSS immunity
vulnerabilities.remediation: Use Set-Cookie with HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Strict flags

recommendations.title: Remove production console.log statements
recommendations.description: 62+ console.log occurrences risk exposing sensitive data in production
recommendations.implementation: Add babel-plugin-transform-remove-console or conditional logging wrapper

recommendations.title: Encrypt localStorage store persistence
recommendations.description: Sensitive store data (agents, CFN loop state) stored unencrypted
recommendations.implementation: Integrate crypto-js AES-256-GCM encryption in store persist middleware

recommendations.title: Migrate JWT storage to HttpOnly cookies
recommendations.description: LocalStorage tokens vulnerable to XSS despite React protections
recommendations.implementation: Backend Set-Cookie header + frontend cookie-based auth flow

recommendations.title: Add dependency security scanning to CI/CD
recommendations.description: Automate vulnerability detection with npm audit or Snyk
recommendations.implementation: Add npm audit --audit-level=high to GitHub Actions workflow
